0022600170.text: The Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak) host the Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) in Golden State's eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Warriors 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 9th in the West, while Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 12th in the West. Golden State is out Draymond Green and Stephen Curry (both rest), Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody (both knee surgery), and Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The Warriors trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on October 24, though they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
